context: M19 o3. Corwin basement, boiler room. Gus beside the main panel. A letterhead order taped to it.

lines.speaker: char.gus_wilkie
lines.text: Orders come on letterhead. I don't argue with letterhead.

lines.speaker: char.gus_wilkie
lines.text: Boiler's from 1911. I'm not a super, I'm a priest. I do last rites.

lines.speaker: char.gus_wilkie
lines.text: Prentiss said two days. Upgrade. I turned the switch. That's all.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Then turn it the other way. Now.
